newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN EXPECTS CAPITAL GAINS FROM PROPERTY '97.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN EXPECTS CAPITAL GAINS FROM PROPERTY '97.

text.p: Swedish forestry company AssiDoman said on Tuesday it expected to see capital gains of about 300 million crowns in 1997 from real estate sales.
The company had earlier calculated on capital gains of about 200 million crowns from property sales.

"We have raised the earlier forecast of about 200 million crowns and we now expect about 300 million crowns for the full year. It is a really good market," AssiDoman's economic director Christina Liffner told a news conference.
In the first half of 1997 AssiDoman saw capital gains of 172 million crowns from property sales.
